title: Dispatch handoff
subject: After-hours callback routine
intro: The opening dispatcher owns the overnight callback list. Each entry should tell them who called, how to reach them and what the customer needs.

sections.heading: At the start of the shift
body: Open the overnight call summaries and check for urgent requests first. Call the customer, offer the next available appointment and record the outcome in the dispatch calendar.

sections.heading: When a detail is missing
body: If a summary leaves out the address or callback number, mark the missing detail in the dispatch notes. Give Douglas the time of the call so he can trace the problem.

next_step: Casey will review the first five callbacks with the dispatcher and send Douglas any questions that customers had to answer twice.
